csv_project_name: Engineering for MEP & Site Infrastructure Renovation
csv_scope_of_work: Study and Design for Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, & Site Infrastructure, Renovation, Repair and Upgrades. Study and Design for Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, & Site Infrastructure, Renovation, Repair and Upgrades. House Doctors will investigate and identify areas within buildings where renovations, repairs or upgrades are required. Projects shall include but not be limited to: Renovations and repairs in educational spaces, research labs and other support areas, including work to achieve ADA compliance Other various renovation/repair projects in other areas which are primarily architectural in scope, but which may include mechanical, electrical, structural and civil components For each project, the selected team will be asked to prepare a scope of work, a fee proposal, and proposed Critical Path Method (CPM) schedule for the project. After review and approval by UMass Chan Medical School (UMCMS), a notice to proceed will be issued to the House Doctor. Firms might be requested to prepare a certifiable study and/or design development and construction documents for the preferred solution as well as perform construction administration .
